fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the public campaign against Al Capone’s presence in Miami and the role of newspapers and officials; discussion of Dade County Republican organizing for the 1928 elections; civic and municipal topics including boiler testing, proposed cuts to the weights and measures department, and consumer prices (milk and rentals). Contains society column items, letters to the editor, and extensive notices and advertising related to the Elks National Convention and grandstand seat sales, along with local business advertisements and entertainment listings.
